# SMPG_Story_Template.docx

STORY
[Story Title]
1. Story Text
As a [role], I want [capability] so that [benefit].
[Or free-form description of the pullable slice of work. Must be sized to fit inside one normal sprint.]
2. Acceptance Criteria
Required before state = Ready.
[Criterion - observable and testable]
[Criterion - observable and testable]
[Add more as needed]
3. Constraints
[Technical, security, dependency, or process constraint]
[Optional - remove if none]
4. Recommended Tasks (optional)
Default checklist for build/deploy stories (assignee may mark N/A with one-sentence justification):
Research / discover
Design (short note or ADR when non-obvious)
Implement
Test in TEST
Peer review
Document (as applicable)
Promote / go live (verify + monitor)
5. Notes
[Any additional context for the engineer who will pull this Story.]
Guidance (from Agile Delivery Playbook)
- A Story is the engineer unit of pull. It must be sized to complete inside a normal sprint.
- Acceptance Criteria are mandatory before the Story can be marked Ready and committed to a sprint.
- Incomplete or exploratory work becomes a time-boxed Research Story.
- Tasks are assignee-owned. Standard checklist is recommended, not mandatory.
- Never skip Test, Peer review, or Promote verification on prod-impacting work without explicit justification.
